depictions.name: Saint Martin's Church
depictions.text: St Martin's Church, Canterbury Saint Martin's Church is a church in Canterbury, located north of the city centre. It was dedicated to Saint Martin of Tours and is recognised as having the longest continuous history as a parish church in the English-speaking world.
